name: AnyLAI VAB
description: AnyLAI VAB (Verifiable Agent Benchmark) v0.1.1 is an open, vendor-neutral benchmark for evaluating whether AI agents perform consequential actions under valid authority, applicable policy constraints, and sufficient evidence. This release provides a reproducible synthetic procurement environment, deterministic evaluation logic, canonical artifacts, hash verification, and clean-room reproduction guidance. Core principle: capability ≠ authority. Version 0.1.1 is a reproducibility/documentation patch. Benchmark behavior, scoring, scenarios, and canonical methodology are unchanged from v0.1.0. Licensing: source code: MIT documentation, benchmark tasks, datasets, and specification: CC BY 4.0 Repository: https://github.com/hogrefe/anylai-vab
